analysis: Both changed files are Swift test files under provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests, so no production code, trust boundary, key handling, attestation path or endpoint changes in this batch. NemotronSuperServingPolicyTests.swift: the visible head text (lines 445-895) is memory-accounting and quote-engine test code. The patch only adjusts expected prefix-bank sizes (lines 297-324) to match a policy change that is not in this batch, such as a smaller image media charge (2.5 GiB / 8 GiB). Those expectations bear on the T-041 prefix-cache bank sizing, but the production policy source is not supplied here, so this pass cannot confirm that the production change is safe. The tests still assert that claims fit under the hard cap, that the load gate fits, that narrower owners keep the minimum requirement, and that vision quotes need the full media charge (lines 491, 499, 637-644, 655-683). NemotronSuperLocalHTTPTests.swift: the patch removes the "body over the 8 MiB encoded ceiling" case from imageRequestsOutsideTheirBoundsAreRefusedWith400 and documents that the upload limit answers 413 first. The base test at lines 149-155 already asserts that localInferenceMaxUploadBytes + 1 yields 413. Auth and 400 refusal coverage remains: the 401 checks at lines 158-163 and 207-211, and the zero-reservation baseline checks at lines 198, 271 and 277. No reduction in security test coverage is evident, though the removed case also covered the encoded-body bound inside the hook. Remaining questions for integration: whether the production NemotronSuperServingPolicy and image-HTTP code in other batches changed the media charge, the bank sizing or the encoded-body bound consistently with these test updates, and whether the cap and admission accounting still hold. No findings from these test-only changes.
